entry.title: Azure/azure-sdk-for-net - Releases - 2026-03-03
entry.content:
Azure.AI.VoiceLive_1.1.0-beta.3

1.1.0-beta.3 (2026-02-26)

Bugs Fixed

  • Added public InterimResponseConfigBase InterimResponse

Azure.Provisioning.Storage_1.2.0-beta.1

1.2.0-beta.1 (2026-03-02)

Breaking Changes

  • StorageAccount.PrivateEndpointConnections has been renamed to StorageAccount.PrivateEndpointConnectionResources and its type changed from BicepList<StoragePrivateEndpointConnectionData> to BicepList<StoragePrivateEndpointConnection>. The old property is preserved but marked as obsolete.
  • StorageActiveDirectoryProperties.DomainGuid has been renamed to StorageActiveDirectoryProperties.ActiveDirectoryDomainGuid. The old property is preserved but marked as obsolete.
  • ExecutionTrigger.TriggerType has been renamed to ExecutionTrigger.TaskExecutionTriggerType with type changed from ExecutionTriggerType to TaskExecutionTriggerType. The old property is preserved but marked as obsolete.

Other Changes

  • Regenerated from Azure.ResourceManager.Storage version 1.6.0 with new API version 2025-06-01.

Azure.Provisioning.ContainerService_1.0.0-beta.5

1.0.0-beta.5 (2026-03-03)

Features Added

  • Regenerated from Azure.ResourceManager.ContainerService version 1.3.1.

Azure.Provisioning.Communication_1.0.0-beta.4

1.0.0-beta.4 (2026-03-03)

Features Added

  • Regenerated from the latest Azure.ResourceManager.Communication package.
  • Updated default API version from 2023-04-01 to 2025-09-01.
  • Added new resources: CommunicationSmtpUsername, EmailSuppressionList, EmailSuppressionListAddress.
  • Added new model: CommunicationPublicNetworkAccess.
  • Added IsLocalAuthDisabled and PublicNetworkAccess properties to CommunicationService.
  • Added ResourceVersions to all resources.
